experience.reason: The prose devolves into repetitive, abstract melodrama that lacks the specific, grounding imagery of earlier nodes, causing the emotional momentum to stall rather than crescendo.

The transition from the visceral, surreal horror of the previous nodes to this abrupt, meta-textual summary breaks the immersive tension and feels like a mechanical reset rather than an organic narrative consequence.

The sudden shift to visceral body horror and predatory cannibalism feels tonally disjointed from the preceding existential melancholy, breaking the established thematic consistency of "wanting" and "silence" without sufficient narrative bridge.

The sudden, jarring shift into visceral body horror and the introduction of an ambiguous "she" disrupts the established psychological intimacy, causing the thematic thread of internal regret to snap into disjointed surrealism.
